lines.quote: Design and implement phased-array beamforming algorithms for Nordkom’s surveillance radar products, including an 8-element linear array receive beamformer with adaptive null steering for the NR-500 maritime radar

Write embedded DSP firmware in C and C++ for Texas Instruments C6000-series processors; responsible for the real-time pulse compression and Doppler processing modules deployed in the NR-500 and NR-700 product lines
Production Python: automated test and calibration scripts (~5,000 lines) integrated into Nordkom’s manufacturing workflow

Conduct RF measurement and characterisation of radar front-end subsystems, including power amplifier linearity testing, receiver noise figure measurement, and antenna pattern verification using Rohde & Schwarz ZVA vector network analysers
applying electromagnetic theory and wave propagation modelling from my Applied Physics background at RRIT to optimise the array aperture geometry and sidelobe suppression strategy
